Join FxPro: a leading international fintech company. Be a part of our expanding international team, with offices in Limassol, London, Nassau, and Dubai. FxPro boasts a diverse workforce of over 500 employees representing 40 nationalities, making it an exciting and dynamic workplace. At FxPro, we see each team member as an integral part of our success story.

We are expanding our team due to a number of exciting developments planned for the near future. This is a role for somebody with strong knowledge of the Figma as well as web design skills (HTML/CSS/UI).

Responsibilities

• Develop high-quality visual content across multiple platforms (web, print, digital, social media, presentations, etc.)
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including marketing, product, UX/UI, and developers
• Contribute to concept development, visual storytelling
• Ensuring deadlines and quality standards are me
• Maintain and evolve brand guidelines

Requirements

• Strong portfolio showcasing design work across a range of media
• Proficiency in Figma, Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator), and 3D software is a plus
• Solid understanding and following of design principles, typography, layout, colour theory, and visual hierarchy
• Familiarity with branding, marketing design, and digital advertising formats
• Attention to detail, creativity, and a user-centered mindset.
Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines

• Experience with 3D graphics, AI-generated content
• Knowledge of HTML/CSS principles (for web collaboration)
• Industry-specific experience is a plus (fintech)

Our benefits

• Excellent compensation package
• Medical insurance
• Provident fund
• In-house gym with a personal trainer
• Free daily lunch catering, snacks, and beverages
• Company discount card for various products & services
• 21 days of annual leave and 10 days of sick leave annually
• Shuttle bus service from Limassol
• Birthday gift
